steps.evidence: README.md:156-162 (pnpm go); package.json:29 go = pnpm db:up && pnpm dev:authzed && turbo run go --concurrency 20

notes: Package manager pnpm (pnpm-lock.yaml, packageManager pnpm@11.7.0, CI pnpm/action-setup); docs agree. Node: engines >=24.0.0 <25, .nvmrc 24.22.2, CI uses .nvmrc. Docker and openssl are required (setup-dev-env.sh checks openssl). 'pnpm go' is both setup and dev start: (1) db:up -> dev:setup (scripts/setup-dev-env.sh: copies .env.example to .env if missing and generates ENCRYPTION_KEY, BETTER_AUTH_SECRET, CRON_SECRET, CUBEJS_API_SECRET, AUTHZED_TOKEN, AUTHZED_DATABASE_PASSWORD with openssl) then docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d; (2) dev:authzed -> waits for spicedb, runs db:migrate:dev (builds @formbricks/database, prisma generate, applies migrations) and authzed:upgrade prepare/check; (3) turbo run go -> builds ai/cache/database/jobs/logger/storage/redis-config, runs @formbricks/database db:setup (migrations + SAML database), starts vite watch builds for surveys/js-core/survey-ui/etc., and next dev -p 3000 --turbopack in apps/web. Decomposed equivalent: env-copy + secret generation, compose-up, workspace-build, prisma:generate, prisma:migrate. No manual env editing is needed for a basic start. Services per README.md:146 and docker-compose.dev.yml: PostgreSQL (pgvector pg18), SpiceDB (authz, required: AUTHZED_ENABLED=true is enforced), MailHog (recorded as mailpit), Valkey (Redis-compatible, recorded as redis), RustFS (S3-compatible object storage, MinIO-like), Formbricks Hub (+hub-worker), Cube. Compose profiles taxonomy, qwen, authzed-tools, authzed-ui are optional and not started by default. Later runs can use 'pnpm dev' (turbo run dev --parallel), mentioned in docs/agents/monorepo-builds.md:75 but not in the README. CONTRIBUTING.md has no setup steps; docs/development/overview.mdx defers to the README.
